goal: A 5-minute playable vertical slice that captures the core fantasy of Palworld: a beautiful third-person world, charming creatures, meaningful interaction, and believable creature behaviour.
bar: The real Palworld. A fresh critic is shown our capture beside an official Palworld frame — same shot type, same resolution, same format, labels stripped, order shuffled — and asked which one is the shipped commercial game. We are done when critics stop reliably picking correctly.
openGaps: Everything: the build is a stub baseline — noise terrain, capsule player, sphere creatures, flat lighting.
Reference gap: only 1 of 17 official stills is early-game peaceful exploration, so interaction_feed has no honest comp and is judged on the art-direction rubric instead.
Reference gap: the trailer never shows a creature noticing an approaching player, so behaviour_approach has no fair comp either and is graded against the 12 written aliveness criteria.

rounds.title: Nine systems built in parallel, then integrated
rounds.summary: Nine builder agents with fresh context, each owning one disjoint system directory, each required to read the art-direction brief, look at the real reference screenshots, and verify against their own rendered output. Then an integration pass to make nine independent parts cohere.

rounds.title: Scaffold, capture harness, blind-A/B tooling
rounds.summary: Engine, system contracts and the deterministic capture harness are working. First run silently screenshotted the loading overlay and still reported OK — fixed, and a frame probe now fails any capture that is blank, uniform, or still showing an overlay.
improvements: Fixed-timestep engine with a system registry; systems never import each other, so builder agents can own disjoint directories without conflicts
Deterministic seeded RNG and noise — same seed always produces the same world, which is what makes round-over-round A/B meaningful
Headless capture harness driving the game through the same input path a human uses
Matched-shot protocol: 6 staged stills + 2 motion strips
Blind A/B pack builder that normalises resolution/format/quality so critics judge the picture, not a technical tell
17 official Palworld reference stills acquired and readable by agents
gaps: Stub art across the board — this round only proves the measuring instruments work
